profileDomain.consumer: VESTA3.90.9a arm64 selected pre2.80/pre2.90 shared-reader branches, actual author-VICS-2004 selected3D domain
profileDomain.notAdmissionRestriction: The two actual examples prove concrete old syntax; record clauses describe the real bounded native branch and must not whitelist only sample hashes, labels or numeric values. Unknown field values/native flags remain typed current/source state, not silently omitted.
profileDomain.historicalQualification: A locked native legacy parameter/consumption freeze does not require all historical manuals/producers. Corrected physical interpretation remains a separate source-qualified path and may never overwrite real legacy consumption.

sourceAndCurrentOwnership.immutableSource: Scene-owned SourceMetadata.tree for document-global graphics/material/LIGHT/SCENE; phase-owned metadata for BOUND/SBOND/planes/thermal/site records. Each record retains ordered original fields, assignment mask, exact RawSpan resource refs and missingness. PLANE and explicitly ignored material/DELOB source rows remain distinct source records.
sourceAndCurrentOwnership.currentDestination: Normative currentStateBinding renderPointer and viewPointer plus exact currentRecordSchema. These are actual current maps, independently preserved from SourceMetadata immutable original history.

proposedCurrentMap.fields: All written/persistent native slots below retain original native width: signed16/I64, int32/I64, u32/fullFlags U64, u8 channel U64, f32 F32Bits, f64 F64Bits; typed owner refs for native phase shapes/polyhedra/bond rules. Named records include all actual current values, including constructor/context-derived fields not assigned by source.
proposedCurrentMap.lights: Full actual current light population, each matrix16f32+direction3f32+position4f32+threeRGBA4u8; preserve native owner/index and actual enable/context flags independently. Do not instantiate missing source lights from guessed defaults.
proposedCurrentMap.otherOwners: Every affected current phase boundary/rule/full flags, current first shape alpha and every existing polyhedron alpha are preserved with actual typed identity refs; SBOND/ATOMP lack of a source assignment never permits incomplete current capture.

sourceAndCurrentOwnership.defaultRule: Only local initializations proved by bytes or separately constructor-bound actual states may be asserted. Every unassigned current property is actual captured context, not source-measured and not guessed default. This rule is a complete future implementation specification, not a request for new target execution or a blanket block because Engine is not yet implemented.

colorF32ToByte: For finite qualified normalized source channel q: f32 multiplication f32(q*255), exact promotion to f64, add exact0.5, floor, native integer narrowing then low8bits. Preserve original exact decimal, parsed f32 bits, native byte and any out-of-range diagnostic separately. Do not use a double-only q*255 calculation, arbitrary epsilon, silent clamp or repair source channels.

MODEL.missingAndDefault: Unassigned scan arguments retain their actual prior native object or scratch state. Never invent zero, identity, false, or a source observation.

ATOMP.actualCurrentConsumption: Every actual four-value row15,15,0,0.500 assigns exactly the first4 conversions. BONDP.actualCurrentConsumption: Argument4 and argument5 alias Scene+0x298, so source5 overwrites source4. Source3 is multiplied by binary32 0.5 and stored at0x29c. SBOND.framing: get_line256 rows to ordinal0; allocates then removes sentinel
SBOND.actualCurrentConsumption: Actual YBa has4 values; CaTi has7. First labels write BondSpec+0x1c/+0x27, max+0x14, optionalKind+0xc, optionalBoundaryMode+0x10, optionalMinimumDistance+0x18. Source ordinal is loop control, not retained native identity. Local optionalSearchByLabel is reset0 each row; optionalShowPolyhedra scratch3d8 is not reset by this branch. Native flags+0x42=u16(1|(scratchShowPolyhedra<<2)|(searchByLabel<<3)). If kind2 and boundaryMode nonzero, native sets boundaryMode2. Preserve actual full rule state, assigned mask and original missingness, not padded modern15-field source. Post-read oldBondPostprocess first calls Scene::UpdateBondsProperties(actual global XStyle), then applies to all current phase rules: kind-1 becomes0 and flagsOR0x5; if both labels contain substringXX sets kind2 and clears mask0x4, else if to-label contains substringXX sets kind1. Exact label equality is not required by native strstr. Source from-label exactlyH orD (firstu16 H-NUL/D-NUL) with native max>exactdouble1.1 sets style byte+0x40=4. Apply only as actual native current compatibility transition; source fields remain unchanged.
SBOND.missingAndDefault: BondSpec constructor binding proves constant bytesffffffff01000000 initialize kind-1/boundaryMode1, minimumDistance+0x18=0 and flags+0x42=1, but geometry/style also reads global configuration. Do not infer the unassigned scratchShowPolyhedra, current style/configuration or any absent source field from these constructor constants. A complete actual current rule contains all flags/fields, irrespective of source missingness.

keywordCoverage.scope: Every header in both retained actual old VICS source files is covered by a concrete record clause or named existing core/thermal contract. This is not a full all-version VESTA or all historical producer certificate.

resourceAndFidelity: Every source raw span resolves to a retained immutable Resource content hash/length, not a local machine path or metadata text without bytes; all original physical line endings and unconsumed suffixes are preserved.

Original source inventory includes discarded materialRGBA0/1, overwritten BONDP value, HKLPP scratch-only RGB, PLANE, DELOB6 rows, missing optional fields and first probeTITLE. They are full source audit units; change/drop/reorder needs explicit loss and cannot be counted as Saved unchanged.

Current audit includes actual all slots/full bitwords/types/light population/rule and dependent-object identities, not just source-replay output. Typed bytes of material classes stay distinct, alpha is not dropped, source float channels are not relabelled byte-equal.
Unknown dependency changes invoke existing E_UNSAFE_SOURCE_REWRITE. Immutable byte-preservation does not alone prove editable current state or native render/physical equivalence.
No graphics value is used to alter scientific site coordinates, thermal tensors, SG operation count, chemistry, or inferred field units.

Verify separate current actual fields through the actual Engine owner getters rather than synthesizing them by replay.

currentStateBinding.renderNode: TaggedVariant NativeLegacyDisplayCurrent1; payload is the entire closed ordinary NativeLegacyDisplayCurrent body recursively lowered to AuditNode. Scene.render itself remains an AuditNode Map; retain its other current members.
currentStateBinding.viewNode: TaggedVariant NativeLegacyViewCurrent1; payload is the entire closed NativeLegacyViewCurrent body recursively lowered to AuditNode. Scene.cameraRaw remains Map and retains other camera members.
currentStateBinding.ownerEquality: Both scene EntityRefs equal the actual containing Scene.id. Every phase owner equals the actual owner of the target definition. Actual definitions come from Source7 existing typed roots, never an archived ordinal or guessed first phase.
currentStateBinding.sourceEntityFallback: Use a real distinct SourceEntity definition only when the actual current native subobject has no qualified SG wrapper; nativeKind identifies the actual subobject and its full current sourceTree is captured. Never fabricate an SG shape/mesh/periodic phase or borrow an unrelated definition merely to satisfy a reference. The actual complete Engine source type is authoritative.
currentStateBinding.trustedPopulation: An independent current snapshot supplies exact ordered light indices, atom-type definitions, phase-boundaries, rules, affected first shapes and every current polyhedron. Each expected target appears exactly once in its role, including inactive/default state. No static sample count, source table or caller omission list can establish completeness.
currentStateBinding.allCurrentWords: Native current rules preserve both f32 distances, both i32 modes, fullu16 flags, styleu8, radius/lineWidth f32 and all4 current color bytes. NBOND1 15-token source records or its two decomposed booleans cannot substitute for this current record or pad a legacy4/7-field source row. Original token count/missingness belongs only to immutable metadata.
currentStateBinding.view: Native actual Scene+0x88 matrix16f64 and +0x108/+0x10c/+0x110/+0x120 fourf32 settings live in cameraRaw current view map independently of source SCENE. This conveys no physical camera frame.
currentStateBinding.lowering: Pass EntityRef/F32Bits/F64Bits through unchanged. Ordinary keys become Map; arrays become Array; schema strings Utf8; native integers I64 (schema preserves range/width). Raw source observations lower separately without live EntityRef aliases. Every reference participates in the existing typed global bijection; current literal species/labels/offset keys never rebind.
currentStateBinding.migration: Source7 already has render/cameraRaw/AuditNode and real owner roots; no SourceDTO root or protocol version change. The closed current type and its role schema must be registered in the shared visitor before complete capture can pass. Actual schema mismatch requires versioned extension or refusal, never replay of source.

finiteDesignWitness.scope: Bounded source-span conservation, selected legacy consumption and full current width/reference lowering/validation; no product codec, actual Engine or target execution.
